subject: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 Capacity to GPU Pools
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 capacity to GPU pools

Team —

Following our quarter planning with Nimbus, Daniel asked us to map the deal forecast to a concrete capacity commitment profile so procurement and infra can align. I attached a first-pass workbook (nimbus_capacity_calc.xlsx) that converts their expected token/month usage into GPU pod-hours and provides a suggested reserve profile (base reserved / burst credit / canary slots). Key asks below: 

- Marissa: can you confirm expected close windows for the three named opportunities in the workbook (Core NLP pilot, API pilot, Enterprise rollout)?
- Ben: can you validate the sales forecast assumptions used for tokens/session and concurrency (sheet "sales_assumptions")?
- Karthik & Laura: can infra/finops sanity-check the cost slices and confirm whether we can guarantee the Q3 reserve without impacting other reserved pools?
- Daniel: please confirm procurement timeline and any PO / contract constraints (cc'd).

Notes: the workbook includes two sizing options — "optimistic" (higher model quantization, aggressive batching) and "conservative" (no quantization changes). The recommendation column suggests starting with conservative reserved capacity for the pilot month, with a 20% burst allocation for production ramp.

Action: please reply with confirmations or redlines by EOD Thursday so we can finalize the weekly Fleet Planning deck.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
Attachments: nimbus_capacity_calc.xlsx (Excel workbook, 3 sheets)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 capacity to GPU pools

Naomi —

Thanks for the calc. Quick read-through notes:

- Sales assumptions look reasonable overall. The tokens/session for the API pilot assume 1.2k median; that's inline with what Daniel quoted but can we get an explicit session distribution from their side? That will change peak concurrency.
- On the conservative vs optimistic rows: optimistic assumes float16 + int8 quant pipeline on some endpoints. If we commit to conservative reserved, we should document the quantization roadmap we expect them to accept later.

I'll ping Daniel for the session distribution and drop a short note with suggested amendments. If we lock conservative reserved for month 1, we should still propose a canary of 2 pods in week 3 to validate autoscaling.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 capacity to GPU pools

Hi Naomi / Ben —

Thanks for the breakdown. Confirming initial assumptions:

- Session distribution: attached a one-pager summary (see link in email) — median session ~1.1k tokens, 99th percentile users at ~7k tokens. Expect steady-state concurrency of ~45 for pilot (2-week window) and ~220 for initial production ramp.
- Procurement timeline: procurement can sign a 3-month pilot SOW within 2 weeks once final numbers are confirmed. PO issuance may take up to 4 weeks post-SOW.

We are comfortable starting with your conservative reserve + 20% burst plan. We'll appreciate an explicit cost-per-pod and an expected monthly bill run rate for the pilot and for the 3-month projection.

Daniel Park
Head of Product, Nimbus Health
daniel.park@nimbushealth.com
Attachment: nimbus_procurement_timeline.pdf (1 page)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 10:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 capacity to GPU pools

Naomi / all —

We reviewed the workbook and the session distro Daniel sent — thanks. Quick infra/finops take: 

- Availability: We have capacity headroom in the us-west reserved pool to serve the proposed conservative reserve for Q3, but committing that reserve will reduce our flexibility for mid-quarter reassignments. We can offer:
  - Option A: Reserve the requested capacity as committed (locks pricing and availability; requires a 3-month minimum).
  - Option B: Offer a blended reserved + burst credit plan where we reserve 60% of the calculated base and allow burst credits up to the 20% in peak weeks. This reduces commit risk for both sides.

- Costing: Per-pod monthly unit was calculated on the conservative sheet; if they accept Option B we can offer a 7% discount on the burst usage blended across the pilot. I'll attach the granular cost slices to the Fleet Planning deck.

Request: Please confirm which option Nimbus prefers. If they want Option A, we need a signoff by next Wednesday to avoid blocking other reserve opportunities.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Infrastructure & Capacity, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@nimbushealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mapping Nimbus Health Q3 capacity to GPU pools — final action items

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps (finalizing for weekly Fleet Planning):

- Nimbus confirmed conservative baseline + 20% burst. (Daniel: thanks for the procurement timeline.)
- Infra prefers Option B (60% reserve + burst credits) to preserve pool flexibility. (Karthik: please add the cost-slice table to the Fleet deck and flag the signoff cutoff date.)
- Sales to confirm exact close target dates for the three opportunities: Marissa to update the workbook by Monday.
- Naomi to produce the one-slide ask for Fleet Planning: clear reserve request, cost delta vs burst, and PO timeline.
- Ben to own the canary allocation plan (2 pods in week 3 of pilot) and capture runbook steps for validation.

Attachments to the Fleet Planning packet: nimbus_capacity_calc.xlsx, nimbus_procurement_timeline.pdf, and the cost slices deck (incoming from Karthik).

If we get Marissa's close dates and Daniel's PO window confirmation by Monday COB, I'll lock the ask into the Fleet Planning deck for Tuesday's review.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
